sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Core Texts

  • Arthashastra (Kautilya): Statecraft
  • Indica (Megasthenes): Social Structure
  • Mudrarakshasa (Vishakhadatta): Political rise

Foreign Accounts

  • Megasthenes (Greek)
  • Deimachus (Syrian)
  • Dionysius (Egyptian)

Mindmap of Sources

  • Indigenous Sources
    • Arthashastra: 15 Adhikaranas (Sections), focusing on taxation, espionage, and law.
    • Puranas: Mention the duration of Mauryan rule.
    • Mudrarakshasa: A historical play detailing Chanakya's diplomatic victory over Nanda ministers.
  • Foreign Accounts
    • Indica: Highlights the 7-fold caste system (socio-occupational).
    • Limitations: Ignorance of Indian languages, tendency to record myths.
